title: Encrypted DNS Discovery RFC 9463 DHCPv4 OPTION_V4_DNR Wire Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned byte-level support for RFC 9463 DHCPv4 OPTION_V4_DNR.
planned_changes:
- Add `EncryptedDnsDiscoveryDhcpv4Option` and nested DNR Instance Data helpers.
- Encode and decode OPTION_V4_DNR tag/length fields and repeated DNR instances.
- Encode and decode RFC 8415 authentication-domain-name wire format.
- Encode and validate IPv4 Addr Length and IPv4 resolver address lists.
- Reuse RFC 9460 SvcParam key/value encoding and reject superseded address hints.
- Support ADN-only mode, Parameter Request List data, RFC 3396 option segmentation, multiple instance parsing, service-priority sorting, and invalid-instance discard.
- Add focused positive and negative tests plus canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused DHCPv4 option tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full solution test before commit.
out_of_scope: Neighbor Discovery encrypted DNS option encoding and padding.
Full DHCPv4 client state and platform resolver configuration.
PKIX certificate validation and encrypted resolver connection establishment.
completion_notes: The DNS adapter now has a trace-owned DHCPv4 OPTION_V4_DNR wire floor that can feed future DHCP client, ProtocolLab, or resolver-selection integration.
